title: Storage Manager: app space
summary: Easy management of your apps internal device storage usage
description:
Struggling with limited space on your device's internal storage? Tired of Play Store updates constantly moving your apps back to internal storage? Frustrated with not knowing which apps can be moved to your SD card or how much storage space your apps are using?

With Storage Manager, you can identify the apps hogging valuable space on your internal storage and easily navigate to the Android settings screen for any selected app, enabling you to make necessary changes and free up space. From clearing cache and moving apps to the SD card, to clearing data and uninstalling apps, it's all just a few taps away.

No need to root your device or rely on other complicated apps. Storage Manager integrates with your device's built-in Android app info screen, ensuring a hassle-free and familiar experience.

Key Features:
- Clear overview of all your installed apps, displaying app icons, names, and storage usage details (internal storage, app size, data size).
- Identify the install location of each app (external, internal, or internal with SD card compatibility).
- View the cache size usage of each app.
- Filter and sort your app list to gain insights into what apps are using your storage.

Filter Options:
- All Apps: Display all apps installed on your device.
- Internal Apps: Show apps installed on internal storage only.
- External Apps: Show apps installed on the external/SD card.
- Starred Apps: Show apps marked as favourites.

Customization of Your Apps List:
- Create a custom app list by starring essential apps to mark as favourites and filter the list to view starred apps exclusively.

Sort Options:
- App Name: Alphabetically order your apps by name.
- Freeable Space: Prioritize apps based on the space that can be freed (movable apps and cache size).
- Internal Usage: Identify apps consuming the most internal storage space.
- App Size: Sort apps by their size, starting from the largest.
- Data Size: Find out which apps utilize the most data storage.
- Last Installed: Order by most recently installed apps.

Take control of your device's storage with Storage Manager and reclaim valuable space for what matters most. Download it now and start freeing up your device storage.
